title: Career Roadmap — Social Media Manager
summary: A Social Media Manager plans, creates, publishes and evaluates content across social platforms to build brand awareness, engage audiences and support business goals. The role combines content strategy, creative production, community management, analytics and campaign coordination.

about.label: Career domain
about.text: Digital Marketing, Social Media, Brand Communication & Content Strategy

blocks.text: A Social Media Manager plans, creates, publishes and evaluates content across social platforms to build brand awareness, engage audiences and support business goals. The role combines content strategy, creative production, community management, analytics and campaign coordination.

items.text: Create content calendars and coordinate content production.
Manage posts, stories, reels, short videos and community interactions.
Monitor engagement, audience growth and campaign performance.
Coordinate influencer partnerships and paid social campaigns.
Maintain brand voice, respond to audience feedback and manage reputational risks.
Prepare performance reports and recommend improvements.

blocks.text: This roadmap assumes a four-year undergraduate programme. For a three-year degree, combine the later milestones.

rows.text: Communication, writing, visual storytelling and social platform fundamentals
Create a sample social media page and content calendar
Content strategy, short-form video, copywriting, community management and analytics
Manage a simulated brand account and produce a monthly report
Paid social advertising, influencer marketing, audience research and internships
Run or assist with a campaign and document its results
Social media strategy, campaign budgeting, reporting and portfolio development
Build three campaign case studies and prepare for placements
Audience personas, content pillars and editorial calendars
Reels, graphics, captions and short-form videos
Replies, moderation, escalation and brand voice
Targeting, campaign objectives and budget allocation
Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager
Reach, impressions, engagement, clicks and conversions
Headlines, calls to action and platform-specific messaging
Brainstorming, caption drafts and reporting support

blocks.text: Complete these five projects during the degree.

items.text: 30-day content calendar: Plan posts, reels, stories and publishing times for a defined audience.

blocks.label: Brand social media audit
blocks.text: Analyse a brand's content, audience engagement, competitors and opportunities.

blocks.label: Short-form video series
blocks.text: Produce five platform-specific videos with different creative hooks.

blocks.label: Campaign strategy
blocks.text: Design a campaign with objectives, audience, creative concepts, budget and KPIs.

blocks.label: Performance dashboard
blocks.text: Use sample data to report reach, engagement rate, click-through rate and conversions.
Label simulated metrics clearly. Do not present hypothetical campaign outcomes as actual results.

blocks.label: Official resources
blocks.text: HubSpot Academy, Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics and Canva Design School.
Certificates can support your learning, but demonstrated content quality, campaign experience and analytics skills are more important.
Social Media Intern · Social Media Executive · Social Media Coordinator · Content Executive
Social Media Manager · Senior Social Media Manager · Social Media Strategist
Social Media Lead · Head of Social Media · Digital Marketing Director · Head of Digital Marketing
Adjacent career options include content strategist, community manager, influencer marketing manager, performance marketer and brand communications specialist.
Explore MICA, IIMC and relevant university programmes. Confirm current course availability, admission requirements, fees and entrance tests through official prospectuses.
A postgraduate degree is not mandatory for most entry-level social media roles. A strong portfolio and practical campaign experience can be sufficient for many positions.
Potential destinations include the UK, USA, Canada, Australia and Singapore. Relevant study areas include digital marketing, social media strategy, strategic communication and content marketing.
Before applying, verify tuition fees, scholarships, programme requirements and work authorisation. An international qualification does not guarantee employment.

rows.text: Build content creation, platform management and analytics skills
Manage brand accounts, budgets and multichannel campaigns

Progress toward digital leadership, consulting or an independent agency

blocks.text: These are illustrative planning horizons, not guaranteed promotion dates.

blocks.label: Primary recommendation
blocks.text: Develop both creative and analytical capabilities. A portfolio that demonstrates content planning, consistent execution and evidence-based performance improvements will help distinguish you from candidates who focus only on posting content.

blocks.label: Verification note
blocks.text: Current vacancies, salaries, internship stipends and institution-specific admission details have not been independently verified.
